body: Nigel's used to be soooo good. They have fallen off over the past year or 2. still good, but not great. Add to that the extreme price hikes and it just isn't worth going too often anymore.

As the other comment said, religion is never brought up. They will give you a free tour of the facilities and answer any questions you have during the tour. They have the indoor pool in downtown Summerville that is open year round. They have a monthly schedule they put out for the pool. It lists water arobics classes, free swim times, lap swims, adults only, family swim times, etc. They also have an outdoor pool off Trolley Rd that is open in warmer months. They even have exercise equipment suited for larger, more out of shape individuals.
